short_bio: Film and television producer, co-founder of Imagine Entertainment and winner of the Best Picture Oscar for A Beautiful Mind.
biography:
Brian Grazer was born in Los Angeles and studied at the University of Southern California. In 1985 he and the director Ron Howard formed Imagine Entertainment.

The company’s films include Splash (1984), Parenthood (1989), Apollo 13 (1995) and 8 Mile (2002). A Beautiful Mind (2001) won the Academy Award for Best Picture.

For television it produced 24 and Arrested Development, and Grazer wrote A Curious Mind (2015) about the conversations he seeks out.
